source: User-provided hotel front-desk operational updates; not final production approval.
rationale: Remove misleading check-in document/deposit statement; update adult breakfast fee, shared-floor utensils and glasses, and bedside light switch. Preserve historical workbook reference and Step2 amendments.

H10.zh-CN: 成人早餐费用为每人35,000韩元。
H10.ja: 朝食の大人料金は1名35,000ウォンです。

H15.ko: 전자레인지와 수저, 젓가락, 나이프, 와인잔은 6층, 10층, 16층에 마련되어 있습니다.
H15.en: Microwaves, spoons, chopsticks, knives, and wine glasses are available on floors 6, 10, and 16.
H15.zh-CN: 6楼、10楼和16楼备有微波炉、勺子、筷子、餐刀和葡萄酒杯。
H15.ja: 6階・10階・16階には電子レンジ、スプーン、箸、ナイフ、ワイングラスをご用意しています。

roomUsage.ko: 객실 조명은 침대 옆 스위치로 켜거나 끌 수 있습니다.
roomUsage.en: You can turn the room lights on or off using the switch beside the bed.
roomUsage.zh-CN: 您可以使用床边的开关打开或关闭客房灯光。
roomUsage.ja: 客室の照明はベッド横のスイッチで点灯・消灯できます。
